text.en:
Upon missing 4? times within 2.5? seconds of each:
Grants +25? Stability for 2.5? seconds.

Buff is removed 1? after second of scoring a hit. Missing again refreshes the duration.

enhanced (
#e Duration after scoring a hit is increased.
)

Upon missing multiple times within 2.5 seconds of each without scoring a hit:
Grants +25? Stability for 2.5? seconds.

Misses in a row required:
• Auto Rifle: 10
• Hand Cannon: 4
• Linear Fusion Rifle, Pulse Rifle: unknown

Buff is removed 1? second after scoring a hit.

enhanced (
#e Deactivation time after scoring a hit is increased.
)

Consecutively missing multiple times within 2.5 seconds of each grants 25? Stability for 2.5 seconds.

Buff is removed 1? second after scoring a Hit. Missing again refreshes the buff duration.

Misses in a row required:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns: 10
• Pulse Rifles: 9
• Hand Cannons: 4
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 2

enhanced (
#e Deactivation time after scoring a hit is increased.
)
